raw:
“I remember a public shower, looking down and seeing this foul puddle around my sandals. There were gray suds pooling there, and then I noticed a clump of hair stretched across the drain. That was the part that really disgusted me—the hair caught there, with the water sitting around it instead of going away.

My attention kept going from the drain back to my feet. The sandals didn’t feel like much of a barrier with that water around them. I was thinking about how to get out without stepping farther into it, but looking for somewhere to put my feet meant looking at the puddle again. Even remembering it, it’s that gray water and the clump of hair that stick with me. I don’t remember who else was there.”
